title: Rust: Mark-and-Sweep GC
description: Implement a simple mark-and-sweep garbage collector in Rust.

steps.title: Heap and Object Representation
steps.description: Define a `GcObject` enum: `Int(i64)`, `Pair(usize, usize)` (object references). Create a `Heap` with `objects: Vec<(GcObject, bool)>` (object + marked flag). Create some objects and print them.
hints: Each object has an index (handle) for reference.

verification.failureMessage: Create heap with Int(42) and Pair(0, 1), print them.

steps.title: Allocation and Roots
steps.description: Add `alloc(&mut self, obj: GcObject) -> usize` that adds an object and returns its index. Add `roots: Vec<usize>` (root pointers). Print heap stats after allocation.
hints: `fn alloc(&mut self, obj: GcObject) -> usize { self.objects.push((obj, false)); self.objects.len() - 1 }`
Roots are references directly accessible (like stack variables).
Roots are the starting point for marking.

verification.failureMessage: Allocate objects and print their indices.

steps.title: Mark Phase
steps.description: Implement `mark(&mut self)`: start from roots, recursively mark reachable objects. For Pair objects, follow both child references. Print the objects that were marked.
hints: Clear all marks first, then start from roots.
`mark_object(idx)`: set marked=true, if Pair, recursively mark both children.

verification.failureMessage: Set roots, run mark, and print which objects are reachable.

steps.title: Sweep Phase
steps.description: Implement `sweep(&mut self)`: iterate objects, remove unmarked ones. Return the number of freed objects. Print objects before and after sweep.
hints: After sweep, all remaining objects are marked=true.
Print: `Freed N objects, N objects remaining`

verification.failureMessage: Run GC cycle and print freed vs remaining objects.

steps.title: Full GC Cycle
steps.description: Combine mark and sweep into `collect(&mut self)`. Create a scenario: allocate objects, set some as roots, run GC, and show which objects survive. Demonstrate that unreachable objects are freed.
hints: Allocate 5 objects, set first 2 as roots, rest are garbage.
Print: `Before: 5 objects, After: 2 objects, Freed: 3 objects`

verification.failureMessage: Run a full GC cycle and print before/after stats.
